info.title: GSC Insights
info.description: Fetch data from GSC Insights reports

get.description: >Requests to this endpoint are free and do not consume any API units.

parameters.description: Project ID. Required when portfolio_id is not provided.
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.description: Portfolio ID. When provided, aggregates data across all GSC-connected projects in the portfolio.
parameters.name: portfolio_id

parameters.description: The start date of the historical period in YYYY-MM-DD format.
parameters.name: date_from

parameters.description: The end date of the historical period in YYYY-MM-DD format.
parameters.name: date_to

parameters.description: The time interval used to group historical data.
parameters.name: history_grouping

parameters.description: The type of search results to return (web, image, video, news).
parameters.name: search_type

parameters.description: A two-letter country code (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2).
parameters.name: country

parameters.description: Filter by device type (DESKTOP, MOBILE, TABLET). If not specified, all devices are included.
parameters.name: device

parameters.description:
Supported fields:
- url

Filter is a JSON string that represents a boolean expression, it should follow the following structure:
```
<bool_filter> ::= { "and" : <bool_filter>+ }
              |   { "or" : <bool_filter>+ }
              |   { "not" : <bool_filter> }
              |   <expr>

<expr> ::= {
             "field" : <dimension|metric>,
             ? "is": <condition>,
           }

<condition> ::= [ "eq", <value> ]
            |   [ "neq", <value> ]
            |   [ "gt", <value> ]
            |   [ "gte", <value> ]
            |   [ "lt", <value> ]
            |   [ "lte", <value> ]
            |   [ "substring", <value> ]
            |   [ "isubstring", <value> ]
            |   [ "phrase_match", <value> ]
            |   [ "iphrase_match", <value> ]
            |   [ "prefix", <value> ]
            |   [ "suffix", <value> ]
```
